{{Quote|The assassin is a Chadra-Fan named Duska Murgo. She's awfully fond of IG assassin droids so I'd keep an eye out for those as well.|[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LV" />}}
'''Duska Murgo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She really appreciated [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] and owned at least one of those droids.<ref name="SWG:LV" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Murgo was recruited by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] to assassinate his main rival on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]]. Jabba was seeking for revenge after [[Arrud Barsoomu]], his right hand enforcer in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], had been killed by members of the [[Valarian Syndicate]]. Lady Valarian soon discovered Jabba's plot and tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Murgo before. The spacer eventually found the Chadra-Fan with an IG assassin droid near Mos Eisley and attacked them. Duska Murgo was killed during the ensuring firefight.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Duska Murgo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Duska Murgo was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Lady Valarian's Quest Series]].<ref name="SWG:LV" />

With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]" on [[August 31]], [[2005]], Lady Valarian's Quest Series was deactivated and Duska Murgo was consequently removed from the game.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref>
